claims.quote: Described from the Mun River, Ubon Ratchathani Province, eastern Thailand, a tributary of the Mekong River, and is known only from the Mekong and Chao Phraya systems.
It has been recorded from Mekong tributaries in Laos and presumably occurs in Cambodia as well.
